_doc: State parity inventory (loading / empty / error / partial) per screen and panel. Read by apps/raft_flutter/test/state_parity_guard_test.dart. screens[].states[]: state = loading|empty|error|partial; variant = optional short text; web = yes|no (does the Web component render a DISTINCT such state); flutter = yes|partial|missing; parityCase = case ids or globs without the theme suffix (e.g. components.list-pages.saved.phone-*); status = covered (needs >=1 parityCase that resolves) | gap (needs justification and size S|M|L) | intentional / na (need justification) | fixing (being fixed in the current branch: needs justification and parityCase; resolution is skipped until it is flipped to covered). Optional: gapKind = case-missing (Flutter has it, no case) | impl-diff (Flutter differs from Web) | invalid-case (case exists but the Web capture does not show the state); caseValidity = react-checked (the cached React capture was inspected and shows the state) | invalid | unchecked. navigationCoverage maps every NavigationRegistry section id and settings tab id to the screen ids that cover it (or a justification string). Add a screen entry (and its states) whenever a screen or panel is added; a registry id that is not mapped fails the guard.
